title: 4 ספרי ילדים שיעזרו להם לעשות יותר דברים לבד

stage.need: Doing things by myself: around 3 many children put on some clothes on their own and settle after a childcare drop off; around 4 they like to be a helper and CDC says simple chores help build independence. AAP: a 3-year-old 'can do more things on their own'.
stage.age_caveat: CDC milestones are what most children (75% or more) do by an age, not a deadline, and AAP says each child develops in their own manner. The three books carry Sifriyat Pijama group ages (2-3, 3-5 and 4-6), not publisher ages. The frame headline says בגיל 3 with הרבה ילדים (Yarin cut בסביבות from that headline) and the caption says some children need more time.

dev_sources.title: Milestones by 3 Years
dev_sources.publisher: CDC, Learn the Signs. Act Early.
dev_sources.quote: Puts on some clothes by himself, like loose pants or a jacket / Calms down within 10 minutes after you leave her, like at a childcare drop off / Developmental milestones are things most children (75% or more) can do by a certain age. / Encourage your child to solve her own problems with your support.
dev_sources.supports: By 3 most children put on some clothes by themselves and calm down soon after a childcare drop off; CDC suggests encouraging them to solve their own problems with support. Read through a fetch tool because the CDC site returns 403 to curl; the quotes are the page's words as the tool returned them.

dev_sources.publisher: CDC, Learn the Signs. Act Early.
dev_sources.quote: Likes to be a "helper" / Let your child help with simple chores, such as bringing in the mail, feeding a pet, or wiping down tables. This helps build independence.
dev_sources.supports: By 4 most children like to be a helper, and CDC says simple chores help build independence. Used for the tidying book and the 'what can you already do alone' questions. Read through a fetch tool (CDC returns 403 to curl).

dev_sources.title: Developmental Milestones: 3- to 4-Year-Olds
dev_sources.quote: No longer a toddler, your 3-year-old can do more things on their own. / Dresses and undresses self (coat, jacket, shirt) / Because each child develops in their own manner, it's impossible to tell exactly when or how they'll perfect a given skill.
dev_sources.supports: AAP: at 3 children can do more things on their own, including dressing and undressing, and each child develops in their own manner. Quotes read straight from the page HTML.

image.rights_note: LumeBook's own catalogue cover art for this book (lumebook.com/book_covers); AVIF converted to PNG with sips, no other change; the renderer draws it as a 3D book with CSS
image.depicts: A toddler girl stands in her bedroom fully dressed (striped shirt, dotted purple dungarees, orange socks, laced sneakers) with her hands on her hips and a gan backpack on her back, next to her bed: dressed and ready for gan, which is the line's idea of getting dressed alone on the first day of gan. The cover shows the result (dressed and proud), not the act of dressing. No lettering anywhere in the picture, so nothing is garbled. The boy variant was not used: it has an English alphabet poster and a book with Latin lettering in the toy box.

lumebook.connection: Second to last of 4 suggestions (3 books and the LumeBook book), in Yarin's format. Catalogue book 25 (ages 3-6, category אומץ ועצמאות) is about a child getting dressed independently on the first day of gan, the same skill as the carousel and the CDC 3-year milestone about putting on some clothes alone. The line says they get dressed alone on the first day of gan; the girl cover shows a dressed child with a gan backpack in her room.

claims.wording_he: ספרי ילדים שיעזרו להם לעשות יותר דברים לבד
claims.supports: AAP: a 3-year-old 'can do more things on their own'. CDC 4 years: simple chores help build independence. The books are an invitation to talk and try; the hook says help, not a result.

claims.wording_he: בגיל 3 הרבה ילדים כבר מתלבשים קצת לבד
claims.supports: CDC 3-year milestone (most children, 75% or more): 'Puts on some clothes by himself, like loose pants or a jacket'. AAP 3 to 4: 'Dresses and undresses self (coat, jacket, shirt)'. קצת stands for 'some clothes'.

claims.wording_he: ספרים על ילדים שמנסים לבד מאפשרים לדבר על זה ולנסות גם בבית
claims.supports: CDC: encourage your child to solve her own problems with your support; simple chores help build independence. The books are framed as an opportunity to talk and try, not as a proven effect.

CDC 4 years: likes to be a helper; simple chores help build independence. AAP: can do more things on their own. The plot (Aviv ends up tidying the room herself) is from the Sifriyat Pijama blurb. The practising happens when parents let the children tidy after the story; the book itself is the prompt.

claims.wording_he: מתרגלים לספר בגאווה שהם הולכים לגן
claims.supports: CDC 3 years: calms down within 10 minutes after a childcare drop off. AAP: a 3-year-old can do more things on their own. The proud telling is from the Sifriyat Pijama blurb ('משתף בגאווה'). The link between a cheerful walk to gan and independence is Sifriyat Pijama's subject tag (עצמאות), not a claim of the CDC page.

claims.wording_he: סיפור מותאם אישית עם תמונות של הילדים שלכם
claims.supports: Live site, read 2026-10-13: parents upload a photo of the child and add the name; the child is the hero of the story.

claims.wording_he: שבו הם מתלבשים לבד ביום הראשון בגן
claims.supports: Live site, read 2026-10-13, book 25: a child facing the challenge of getting dressed independently on the first day of gan.
CDC 3 years: puts on some clothes by himself. Ties the LumeBook line to the carousel's skill; no claim that the book teaches it.

claims.wording_he: מתרגלים לגלות שאפשר להיכנס לגן לבד
claims.supports: CDC 3 years: calms down within 10 minutes after you leave her, like at a childcare drop off. AAP: can do more things on their own. Emilia wanting to go into gan alone is from the Sifriyat Pijama page. The question is adapted from its activity.

notes: Books research read on 2026-10-13 (the run started 12 Oct 22:06 and the reading happened after midnight, so every accessed and checked_at date is 13 Oct, not 12 Oct). Stage: independence, 3 to 4. Candidates came from Sifriyat Pijama's עצמאות subject page; programme facts were read on each book page, availability and prices on Tzomet Sfarim (booknet.co.il). Dropped: לפעמים גדול לפעמים קטן (אורה איתן, the best fit: dressing alone) because no Israeli retailer listing could be found today (not on Tzomet Sfarim, not in Steimatzky's search, not on the Magnes site); יוסי ילד שלי מוצלח (ע. הלל) because Tzomet Sfarim shows אזל זמנית and Steimatzky חסר זמנית; מסע לגיל ארבע (author, illustrator and publisher all used in the last 14 days, not found on Tzomet Sfarim). Steimatzky blocks curl and its search shows חסר זמנית on almost every result through the fetch tool, so it was not used as availability evidence. CDC pages return 403 to curl, so the CDC quotes came through a fetch tool; the HealthyChildren quotes were checked against the page HTML. No Israeli bestseller ranking was read for any book: the popularity evidence is the Sifriyat Pijama selection only.
